summary: Create roller coasters, test fun rides and explore a magical theme park
description:
IMAGINE YOUR PARK… THEN BRING IT TO LIFE!
Start by drawing your roller coasters, placing your favorite rides, and inventing your own theme park: slides, Ferris wheel, fortress, giant rocket, haunted mansion… here, you’re the one in charge!

Place Pango and his friends in the rides: they slide, fly, spin, and react to everything you build. The park comes alive before your eyes.

Pango Build Park is an open-ended construction game that develops creativity, logic, exploration, and fine motor skills. An open, intuitive, and evolving experience, perfectly suited to children aged 3+.

A PANGO CREATION
With over 15 years of experience and more than 15 million children delighted worldwide, Pango has become a trusted reference for parents seeking smart, calm, and caring games.
Pango Build Park continues this mission: a captivating construction game designed to foster creativity, independence, and the joy of building.

WHY PARENTS LOVE PANGO BUILD PARK?
- Stimulates imagination and creativity
- Develops logic, organization, and motor skills
- Introduces cause-and-effect through interactive attractions
- 100% free construction: children create, modify, and reinvent freely
- A lively, joyful world with no competition
- Immediate handling, perfect for little hands
- Pre-built parks to support younger children

A 100% SAFE GAME FOR CHILDREN
• No in-app purchases
• No advertising
• No external links
• Built-in parental control
• Compliant with children's data protection standards

PANGO VALUES: CREATIVITY, KINDNESS, FREEDOM
At Pango, we create experiences designed at a child’s height: simple, joyful, and enriching. Our games nurture curiosity, encourage independence, and build self-confidence.

Need help? A question? pango@studio-pango.com

More info: www.studio-pango.com

DOWNLOAD PANGO BUILD PARK and let your child imagine, build, and bring their own theme park to life: A WORLD TO BUILD, A THOUSAND STORIES TO CREATE!
